# HelixCore Studio

> HelixCore Studio (Private) Limited is a software and game development studio in Lahore, Pakistan. Services include Unity game development, playable and video ads, custom AI, web applications, and Shopify development.

Last reviewed: 2026-11-12

## Company
- [Official website](https://helixcorestudio.com/): Services and published work.
- [Team](https://helixcorestudio.com/team): Studio leadership and team information.
- [Hamza Hakim](https://helixcorestudio.com/hamza-hakim): CEO and game developer portfolio.
- [Company LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/helixcore-studio/): Official company profile.
- [Company YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@HelixCoreStudio): Gameplay and studio videos.
- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/HelixCoreStudio/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/helixcorestudio/), and [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@helixcore.studio): Studio social profiles.
- [Clutch](https://clutch.co/profile/helixcore-studio) and [GoodFirms](https://www.goodfirms.co/company/helixcore-studio): Third-party company listings.
- [Hamza Hakim on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/hamza-hakim1/): Leadership profile.
- [Contact](https://helixcorestudio.com/#contact): Project inquiries.

## Published work
- [Google Play developer portfolio](https://play.google.com/store/apps/dev?id=6757601249402259430): Android games published by HelixCore Studio.
- [Smash Fest](https://helixcorestudio.com/smash-fest): Studio-developed Android physics puzzle with limited-shot levels and destructible towers.
- [Smash Fest on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.flow.cannonball.smash.carnival): Screenshots, release notes, and player reviews.

## Services
- [Mobile and PC game development](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/game-development): Prototyping, production, and release planning.
- [Unity game development](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/unity-game-development): 2D and 3D gameplay, platform builds, and device profiling.
- [Smash Fest case study](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/unity-game-development#smash-fest-case-study): Gameplay decisions and evidence from the Android release.
- [Playable ads](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/playable-ads-development): Interactive HTML5 ad production.
- [Video ads](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/video-ads-development): Gameplay footage and short-form ad variants.
- [Custom AI development](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/ai-development): AI applications, integrations, and automation.
- [AI agent development](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/ai-agent-services): Workflow pilots, tool integrations, evaluation, and human approvals.
- [Business automation](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/automation-services): API integrations, data pipelines, and workflow automation.
- [Custom web development](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/web-development): Web apps, APIs, and software integrations.
- [Full-stack development](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/full-stack-web-development): Frontend, backend, and deployment.
- [Shopify and ecommerce](https://helixcorestudio.com/services/ecommerce-development): Storefronts, migrations, and integrations.
- [All services](https://helixcorestudio.com/services): Full service directory.
